topic: Testing before launch: 5 checks that catch bugs before users do
caption:
Your users shouldn't be your testers. 5 checks to run before launch. 🧪

1️⃣ The core journey, end to end
2️⃣ Real devices and browsers
3️⃣ Bad input and bad connections
4️⃣ Permissions and roles
5️⃣ A quick load test

A bug found before launch costs minutes. The same bug found by users costs reviews and trust. Swipe for what to check in each. →

slides.title: Your users shouldn't be your testers.
slides.sub: 5 checks to run before you launch. Swipe →

slides.title: The core journey, end to end.
slides.body: Sign up, do the main thing, pay, log out. Walk it like a new user, every time something changes.

slides.title: Real devices and browsers.
slides.body: Test on real iPhones and Android phones, small screens, and the browsers your users actually use.

slides.title: Bad input, bad connections.
slides.body: Empty forms, odd characters, slow or dropped networks. Your app should fail gracefully, not crash.

slides.title: Permissions and roles.
slides.body: Can a regular user reach admin pages? Check every role sees only what it should.

slides.title: A quick load test.
slides.body: Launch day brings a spike. Simulate many users at once and see what slows down first.
